name: merge-divergent-collision-target-wins
description: Pins the LEGACY SQLITE FAMILY's collision behavior (frozen KEEP fence, byte-identical pre-arrival ceremony): on primary-key ID collision with divergent payload content, ATTACH + INSERT OR IGNORE preserves the target's version and counts the source's as skipped. SCOPE — this vector executes the sqlite arm only. The ARRIVAL arm REFUSES the same collision (MergeDivergence, decision:design/arrival-branch-r1-rulings CX-BR-01, per the admission table in decision:design/arrival-substrate-laws); that refusal is pinned by libs/store/tests/test_arrival_merge.py::TestDivergenceRefusal.
